parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small flush button located on the top of the toilet tank, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism to release water from the tank into the bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid (Tank Lid)
parts.Basic_description: A ceramic cover placed on top of the toilet tank to enclose the flushing components.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the internal flushing mechanism and provides a flat surface for the button.
parts.Movement_description: It is removable but typically remains stationary during normal use.

parts.name: Lid (Seat Cover)
parts.Basic_description: A plastic lid that covers the toilet seat when not in use.
parts.Functional_description: It provides hygiene and aesthetic coverage for the toilet bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward and downward around a hinge at the back of the seat.

parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: A contoured plastic ring attached to the toilet bowl for sitting.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a comfortable and hygienic surface for the user to sit on.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate upward and downward around the hinge for cleaning or access.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main ceramic structure of the toilet that includes the bowl and tank.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat and contains the water for flushing and waste removal.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor and plumbing system.
